specs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET is the supplied existing square 4m game floor base-color texture. Return ONLY the finished square diffuse/albedo texture, edge-to-edge orthographic TOP DOWN, no labels, no art board, no perspective, no room render. Preserve its exact 2-by-2 tile layout: four equally sized large square metal plates, thin recessed horizontal/vertical seams at x=50% and y=50%, outer seams at image edges for repeat. Maintain this tile scale; do not add more plates. Rich blue-violet painted industrial metal, deep midnight indigo crevices, desaturated periwinkle/light steel-blue raised faces, visible pale lavender and cold ivory chipped bevel highlights, SMALL muted copper/russet underpaint chips. Expressive Warcraft/League-of-Legends-quality hand-painted environment art: decisive broad angular brush planes, deliberate light/dark groups, irregular chunky edge wear and painted ambient occlusion, NOT a smooth flat tint, NOT photoreal noise, NOT glossy PBR or soft empty gradients. Emphasize readable medium-scale forms and detailed beautiful closeup brushwork. Strong artwork painted INTO this base color, with no later shader repainting needed. Each of the four plates has a distinct hand-painted surface: broad planar midtone shapes, darker colored pooled corner grime, a few long directional scratches with dark incision and light rim, rubbed scuffs, clustered paint chips and small bolt heads NEAR tile corners. Attractive asymmetric wear and subtle creases; large centers still readable but clearly painted rather than blank. Strong bevel shading and broken thick edge highlights, from upper-left, dark lower-right. No hazard stripes, words, logos, cables, glow, props or deep holes. Keep all image boundary strips seam-compatible with opposite edges; no unique object cut at outer border. Never use vignette or global central lighting. Output a single high-resolution 2048x2048 complete color texture, OPAQUE.
